title: Settings » Text Labels

## Settings » Text Labels


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682673


## Overview


Customizing the text used throughout a site is useful, but it can become a long process when the same text must be changed repeatedly across many different pages of the site.

For example, the word "company" is used on many pages throughout the site, but some website owners may prefer a different word, such as "startup," depending on the site.

The good news is that a single update can change the same word everywhere it appears across the site. This feature is called Text Labels .

>> How To Locate Text Labels On The Front End Of A Website


## Using Text Labels


The following steps outline how to access and update all Text Labels on the site:

- Navigate to Settings » Text Labels.

- Enter the text to be replaced into the search field: Typing in this field automatically filters the list of Text Labels to show only matching results:

- Once the Text Label is located, replace the existing text in the field with the new text, then save the changes.


### Sorting and Last Edited Date


Each Text Label in the list includes a line showing when it was last edited. A sort dropdown above the list allows the results to be ordered by name (A to Z or Z to A) or by last edited date (most recent first or oldest first).

Sorting by most recently edited is a quick way to identify which Text Labels have changed and when, which is useful when reviewing a recent wording update on a site.


## Text Label Pluralization


By default, if a Text Label is surrounded by two percentage signs, the system pluralizes the value by adding an "s."

More information regarding how percentage signs work can be found in the article below:

Using Text Labels with Percentage Shortcode

Some Text Labels have a Plural Version variable; when that is the case, the system uses that value instead.

Example: By default, the system adds an "s" to the end of the word "client" when using the plural version of the following Text Label:

If a different value is needed instead of "Clients," the Plural Version of the Text Label can be used; the system will use this value instead:

Note : When the Default Website Language is set to a language other than English and the " Use same language for text labels and email templates " option is enabled, the system automatically disables auto-pluralization to ensure accurate text display.
